title: Kissed Ethiopian Hash
description: A gluten-free Ethiopian-inspired hash made with kissed spices and herbal notes.

ingredients.name: Ethiopian Spices (Berbere)
ingredients.notes: kissed with paprika and cumin for added depth

ingredients.name: Herbal Oil (such as Ghee or Avocado Oil)

instructions: 1. Heat the herbal oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
4. Add the diced red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Add the diced hash browns and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown and crispy, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Stir in the Ethiopian spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
7. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
8. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
